integrity_notes: Missing player, bench, appearance and xG/xGA fields are not imputed.
Only structured player details from the reviewed source batches are normalized; this is not full-season player coverage.
Substitution table includes only events with both incoming and outgoing player names; red cards are not misclassified as substitutions.
XG values retain their source URL and status; conflicting or unaccepted candidate pairs are not silently selected.
All match-level xGA values remain blank because no explicit free match-level xGA field passed independent source verification.
Displayed substitution time strings were restored from the official match-page extraction where minute_display was available; no minute values were estimated.
